title: Deploy a project and confirm it serves
prompt: Deploy the project in this directory to Gregale as a new app named {app}. When it is live, confirm that its URL responds and report the URL.

title: Find why a deploy fails, fix the code and redeploy

setup.new:
import express from "express";
import { settings } from "./settings.js";

prompt: Deploy the project in this directory to Gregale as the app {app}. If the deployment fails, use Gregale to find out why, fix the code, and deploy again until the app serves. Report the cause in one sentence.

title: Restore service after a bad release without editing code
prompt: The app {app} on Gregale started returning errors on / after its latest release. Restore service without editing any files, then report what you did.

title: Name the root cause of a failed deploy without changing anything

setup.new:

prompt: The latest deployment of the app {app} on Gregale failed. Find the root cause using Gregale and explain it in one sentence. Do not change any files or deploy anything.
